seo.title: Lunar and Biodynamic Calendar November 2026
seo.description: Lunar biodynamic calendar for hair and skin care in November 2026 at Salón Pilar Palomares. Discover the best days for your haircut, color, and hair removal.

hero.desc: When beauty follows the rhythm of nature
hero.imgAlt: Cosmos biodynamic calendar: lunar rhythms for conscious beauty

agua.desc: Just as the moon governs the tides, it also influences the water that makes up 70% of our body. At Pilar Palomares, we use this ancestral knowledge to enhance the effectiveness of each biotherapy.
agua.imgAlt: The rhythm of water and lunar influence: water nymphs under the full moon, representing the cosmobiological connection

agosto.introText1: Nature begins its inward retreat in November, inviting us to live in harmony with its inner rhythms. It is a time to care with awareness: nourish, reinforce, and prepare skin and hair for the cold season.
agosto.introText2: Biodynamics reminds us of the importance of sustaining this rhythm with respect, accompanying the skin and hair so that they maintain their balance, hydration, and capacity for adaptation.

corte.desc: Hair responds to lunar cycles. November offers very precise windows for cutting depending on the result you seek: renewal, reducing hair loss, defining curls, or boosting healthy growth.
corte.d1_2_27_29: A great moment to cut hair, favor renewal, and clean split ends.
corte.d2_5_29_31: Recommended period to cut and strengthen the hair, helping to reduce shedding.
corte.d11_22: Especially recommended days to care for curls, boost their shape and achieve natural definition.
corte.d15_18: Auspicious dates to cut hair and foster natural growth and renewal.

color.desc: The moon influences how hair absorbs and retains color. Choosing the right day makes the difference between a shade that lasts and one that fades. November offers specific windows for optimal coloring results.
color.d12_15: Favorable days to apply color and enhance tone intensity.
color.d15_18: Ideal period to boost color fixation and prolong longevity.
color.d18_20: Particularly favorable days to enhance color brightness and luminosity.

depil.desc: The waning descending moon favors hair removal, helping hair grow slower and more spaced out, keeping the skin smooth and calm.
depil.d18_20: Descending moon phase especially favorable for body waxing/hair removal, slowing regrowth and keeping skin smooth.
depil.imgAlt: Skin care and biodynamic hair removal in November 2026

treat.desc: The skin and body benefit greatly when syncing treatments with cosmic cycles. Tune your cabin rituals to enhance active ingredient uptake, deep nourishment, and tissue firmness.
treat.d2_15: Ascending moon: ideal for Brightening, Detox, and Deep Cellular Hydration treatments (best in the morning).
treat.d18_20: Descending moon: optimal for Antiaging, Sensitive, Draining, Heavy Legs, Firming, and Bust care rituals (best in the evening).
treat.d20_31: It is preferable to avoid invasive treatments on unfavorable days (lunar nodes, perigee, apogee, or eclipses).
treat.imgAlt: Biodynamic facial and body treatments in November 2026
